title: Linux Kid Lab
summary: Pick 20 short creative activities for children on a Linux family computer.
user: Parents using Linux who need a calm, age-progressive set of local creative activities after a child outgrows a first educational app.
smallest_useful_product: A local-first web launcher with 20 short open activities, parent-selected age bands, no ads, printable progress tokens, and links to installed tools.
success_measure: In ten household trials, six children independently return to a second activity on three separate days.
monetization: one-time — parents can buy a curated offline pack; no data business is needed.
constraints: No behavioral data or chat; clearly license any linked/open assets; keep all copy age-appropriate and accessible.
